controls.act: Corporate Governance Guidelines for Commercial Banks, Merchant, Non-Interest and Payment Service Banks and Financial Holding Companies in Nigeria
controls.title: Board Structure and Composition
controls.control: - Board Charter detailing structure and appointment process.- Maintain Board composition matrix and succession plan.- Track disclosures and CBN approvals.- Implement resignation procedures.- Annual board structure review.
controls.additionalControl: - Regular Board evaluation against CBN and NCCG criteria.- Board diversity targets and rotation mechanisms.- Training for directors on regulatory expectations.
controls.responsibilityText: Board Nomination and Governance Committee (BNGC)Company SecretaryManaging Director/CEO
controls.reason: Company Secretary is the single accountable party for board structure, composition, succession, disclosures, and CBN approvals; BNGC and MD/CEO are contributors.

controls.title: Roles & Responsibilities of the Board
controls.control: Board Charter; Annual Strategy Review; Board Committee Charters; ERM Framework; AML/CFT policies; IT Framework; CBN “No Objection” protocols; Delegation framework; Performance evaluation; Succession Plan
controls.additionalControl: Annual Board Effectiveness Evaluation; Independent Board Assessment; Director training and re-certification
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary / Compliance Officer / Board Chair
controls.reason: Board of Directors is the governing body, but the Company Secretary is the accountable officer for board charters, evaluations, training, and succession documentation.

controls.title: Officers of the Board
controls.control: Fit-and-proper checks, CBN No-Objection, appointment logs, INED independence reviews, tenure tracking, internal declarations, board matrix, succession plan
controls.additionalControl: Annual INED independence review, role separation policy, Board Charter updates
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary / Board Chair / HR Governance
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for fit-and-proper checks, CBN No-Objection, appointment logs, INED independence reviews, tenure tracking, and board matrix.

controls.title: Access to independent Professional Advice
controls.control: Formal procedure for requesting and approving external advice; board resolution logs; advice repository
controls.additionalControl: Annual board training on advisory rights; internal checklist for compliance with advice documentation
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for the formal procedure for independent professional advice, board resolution logs, and advice repository.

controls.title: Meetings of the Board and its committees
controls.control: Annual board calendar, virtual meeting policy, attendance monitoring, quorum verification, structured minute-taking process, reappointment checks.
controls.additionalControl: Annual review of board effectiveness, automated attendance tracking, periodic board governance training.
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary, Board Committees, Governance & Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for board calendar, meeting policies, attendance monitoring, quorum verification, and minute-taking.

controls.title: Board Committee
controls.control: Board-approved charters; Annual Governance Evaluation; Training records for BAC members; Minutes of meetings; Independence confirmations; Attendance logs
controls.additionalControl: Periodic review of governance practices; Independent external review of Board effectiveness
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretary; Board Chairman; Board Governance Committee
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Board; Company Secretary; Governance & Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for board committee charters, governance evaluation, training records, minutes, independence confirmations, and attendance logs.

controls.title: Cool off period
controls.control: Maintain Director and Auditor Transition Log; require mandatory declarations; board-level fit and proper checks; monitor audit firm rotation and conflict checks
controls.additionalControl: Board-level review of all new appointments; Pre-engagement independence checklists for auditors; Notify CBN of changes if required
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretary, Head HR, Internal Audit, Board Nomination Committee, Audit Committee
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary (for board roles); Internal Audit & Audit Committee (for audit firms and independence checks); HR (employment changes)
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for director and auditor transition log, declarations, and board-level fit and proper checks; HR and Internal Audit contribute for employment and audit firm matters.

controls.title: Cummulative tenure
controls.control: Maintain a Board Tenure Register, monitor tenure limits, periodic board composition review, enforce exit timelines.
controls.additionalControl: Automated alerts in board database, annual board evaluation and succession planning.
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary, Board Governance & Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for maintaining the Board Tenure Register, monitoring tenure limits, and enforcing exit timelines.

controls.title: Induction and Continuing Education
controls.control: Scheduled induction sessions; training records; annual board-approved training budget; regular training implementation tracking.
controls.additionalControl: Use of external governance training providers; integration of training in board calendar; periodic reporting to the Board.
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretary; Board Governance & Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for induction sessions, training records, board-approved training budget, and implementation tracking.

controls.title: Board Evaluation
controls.control: Engage qualified external consultant; ensure board evaluation scope aligns with CBN guidelines; set annual calendar reminders for report preparation and submission.
controls.additionalControl: Escalate evaluation results to Board for follow-up; maintain performance log for each director; link evaluation outcomes to reappointment decisions.
controls.responsibilityText: Board Chairman; Company Secretary; Board Governance & Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for engaging external consultants, aligning evaluation scope with CBN guidelines, and maintaining performance logs.

controls.title: Remuneration
controls.control: Documented remuneration policy; annual performance-linked reviews; shareholder approvals; proper disclosure in annual report; compliance with share option conditions.
controls.additionalControl: Independent benchmarking of remuneration levels; clear risk-control checks on performance-linked incentives; external audit review of compliance with policy.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of Directors; Board Governance and Remuneration Committees; MD/CEO; Company Secretary
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Board Governance & Remuneration Committee; Company Secretary
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for documented remuneration policy, annual reviews, shareholder approvals, disclosure, and share option compliance.

controls.title: Risk Management Function
controls.control: Financial statement checks; public disclosures
controls.additionalControl: Internal audit verification
controls.reason: Risk Management Dept. is accountable for financial statement checks and public disclosures; Company Secretary contributes on disclosure governance and Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Internal Audit Function
controls.control: - Ensure robust internal audit structure is in place.- Conduct annual independent audit effectiveness assessment.- Implement CBN's fit and proper criteria for internal auditors.- Maintain reporting line directly to BAC.
controls.additionalControl: - Conduct internal reviews before external assessment.- Maintain updated records for CBN audit compliance.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of DirectorsManaging Director/CEOBoard Audit Committee
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company SecretaryHead, Internal AuditBoard Audit Committee
controls.reason: Internal audit function ownership clearly sits with Head of Internal Audit; Board/CEO provide oversight, Company Secretary maintains records. Compliance verifies CBN audit compliance.

controls.title: Compliance Function
controls.control: CBN pre-approval template; reporting line chart
controls.additionalControl: HR and Legal validation
controls.reason: Compliance function ownership with Head of Compliance; HR and Legal validate. Internal Audit independently verifies.

controls.title: Whistle-Blowing
controls.control: Whistle-blowing policy, anonymous reporting channels, staff awareness
controls.additionalControl: External reporting channel (hotline), quarterly Board review of whistle-blowing reports
controls.responsibilityText: Head of Compliance / Ethics & Integrity Unit
controls.reason: Whistle-blowing explicitly assigned to Head of Compliance / Ethics & Integrity Unit, mapped to Conduct & Ethics.

controls.title: Compliance Function
controls.control: - Maintain calendar for auditor submission deadlines.- Enforce policies restricting external auditors from providing prohibited services.- Ensure timely publication of audited statements.- Conduct annual review of auditor’s compliance and independence.
controls.additionalControl: - Auditor engagement letter should clearly list restricted services.- Pre-approve all auditor activities through the BAC.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of DirectorsManaging Director/CEOChief Compliance OfficerExternal Auditor
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company SecretaryChief Compliance OfficerBoard Audit Committee
controls.reason: Chief Compliance Officer accountable for auditor compliance and independence; Board/CEO oversight, Company Secretary records. Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: General Meetings
controls.control: - Schedule meetings at accessible venues. - Consider venue rotation annually. - Implement secure virtual meeting options. - Document meeting format decisions.
controls.additionalControl: - Annual review of meeting strategy. - Shareholder feedback surveys.
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretariat, Legal, Investor Relations, IT
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Board Secretary, Head of Legal, Investor Relations, Head of IT
controls.reason: Company Secretariat owns general meeting logistics; Legal, IT, and Board contribute. Compliance verifies governance adherence.

controls.title: Treatment of Shareholders
controls.control:
i. Shareholder monitoring systems

ii. SEC Code of Conduct compliance checks

iii. Board oversight on ownership changes

iv. CBN approval workflow embedded in share acquisition process
controls.additionalControl:
i. Annual audit of shareholder structure

ii. Periodic training on NCCG and SEC requirements
controls.responsibilityText: Board Secretary, Legal, Investor Relations, Compliance
controls.reason: Board Secretary/Company Secretariat accountable for shareholder treatment; Legal and Compliance contribute. Internal Audit verifies shareholder structure.

controls.title: Business Conduct and Ethics
controls.control: - Maintain a published, updated Code of Ethics.- Conduct periodic staff training on the Code.- Set up ethics reporting and whistleblowing channels.- Schedule triennial review of the Code.
controls.additionalControl: - Include Code of Ethics compliance in internal audit scope.- Monitor staff disclosures and conflicts of interest.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of DirectorsChief Compliance OfficerCompany Secretary
controls.reason: Code of Ethics ownership with Chief Compliance Officer; Board and Company Secretary contribute. Internal Audit includes ethics in scope.

controls.title: Related Party Transactions
controls.control: - Establish and publish a Related Party Transactions & Insider Trading Policy.- Conduct regular internal audits on related party compliance.- Maintain a log of director-related loans and monitor performance.- Enforce disqualification rules for non-performing insider obligations.
controls.additionalControl: - Conduct training on insider rules and disclosure requirements.- Review related party transactions at Board and Audit Committee levels.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of DirectorsChief Compliance OfficerChief Audit ExecutiveHR & Legal Departments
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Chief Compliance OfficerHead of Internal AuditCompany Secretary
controls.reason: Chief Compliance Officer accountable for related party policy; multiple contributors including Internal Audit and Legal. Internal Audit verifies compliance.

controls.title: Conflict of Interest
controls.control: - Implement Conflict of Interest Policy approved by the Board.- Maintain Board minutes that document conflict concerns.- Establish periodic conflict declaration procedures for directors.
controls.additionalControl: - Annual conflict of interest disclosures by directors and senior executives.- Training and awareness on conflict identification and management.
controls.responsibilityText: Board of DirectorsCompany SecretaryChief Compliance Officer
controls.reason: Company Secretary owns conflict of interest declarations and Board minutes; Board and CCO contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Sustainablity
controls.control: - ESG Policy aligned with NCCG & NSBP - Sustainability risk integration into ERM - Annual ESG/sustainability disclosures
controls.additionalControl: - Periodic training on NSBP/NCCG - ESG performance audits - Stakeholder engagement reports
controls.responsibilityText: Board Sustainability Unit Risk Management Compliance
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Sustainability Unit Risk Management Internal Audit
controls.reason: ESG risk integration into ERM points to Enterprise Risk; Board, Compliance, and Internal Audit contribute. Ambiguous due to 'Sustainability Unit' not in org structure.

controls.title: Stakeholder Communication
controls.control: - Functional website and secure channels of communication - Stakeholder communication policy approved by the Board - Whistle-blowing framework (including escalation to CBN for Board-related issues)
controls.additionalControl: - Regular website reviews - Periodic stakeholder engagement reviews - Awareness training on reporting channels
controls.responsibilityText: Board; Company Secretary; Chief Compliance Officer; Corporate Communications
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary Compliance Officer Corporate Communications
controls.reason: Company Secretary accountable for stakeholder communication policy; Board, CCO, and Compliance contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.act: Re: Status of Chief Compliance Officers
controls.title: Circular
controls.control: HR policy, updated job profiles, compliance org chart
controls.additionalControl: Annual structure review by Governance Committee
controls.reason: HR policy and job profiles for CCO sit with HR; Board and CEO oversight, Compliance contributes. Compliance verifies governance structure.

controls.act: Trade Marks Act
controls.title: Effect of non-registration
controls.control: Ensure all bank-owned trademarks are registered.
controls.additionalControl: Trademark audit every 12 months
controls.reason: Primary responsibility for trademark registration sits with Legal/IP Team, mapped to Legal Advisory. Compliance contributes via audit. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Registration to be in respect of particular goods
controls.control: Verify classification with Registrar or IP Counsel.
controls.additionalControl: Consult IP law firm for class guidance
controls.reason: Legal/IP Team responsible for classification verification; Legal Advisory is the appropriate unit. No additional contributors listed.

controls.title: Right given by registration in Part A
controls.control: Maintain updated trade mark register; monitor market for infringement; initiate legal action if infringement occurs.
controls.additionalControl: Include trade mark enforcement clauses in contracts and agreements; conduct periodic IP audits.
controls.reason: Legal/Compliance jointly responsible; Legal Advisory leads. Brand Management is a contributor. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Right given by registration in Part B.
controls.control: Low
controls.additionalControl: At registration and before enforcement
controls.responsibilityText: Legal review of trademarks; due diligence on branding and usage.
controls.reason: Primary control text is 'Low', which is nonsense. Best inference is Legal review of trademarks. Low confidence due to ambiguous text.

controls.title: Distinctiveness needed for registration in Part A.
controls.control: Pre-registration legal assessment of trademark distinctiveness; use of intellectual property (IP) consultants
controls.additionalControl: Maintain a repository of approved branding elements; include IP checks in product/brand launch process
controls.reason: Legal & Compliance Department leads pre-registration assessment; Legal Advisory is the unit. Compliance and Marketing contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Capability of distinguishing needed for registration in Part B.
controls.control: Trademark review with legal/IP advisors; evidence of usage and market presence
controls.additionalControl: Maintain documentation of usage and market recognition to support distinctiveness
controls.reason: Similar to idx 4: Legal & Compliance Department responsible; Legal Advisory leads. Compliance and Marketing contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Deceptive or scandalous matter not registrable.
controls.control: Legal and ethical review of trademark elements prior to application
controls.additionalControl: Conduct stakeholder review (Legal, Branding, Ethics Committee) before submission
controls.reason: Legal & Compliance Department responsible for legal and ethical review; Legal Advisory leads. Compliance and Marketing contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Identical and resembling marks not to be registered
controls.control: Conduct comprehensive trademark search and legal due diligence before application
controls.additionalControl: Use professional trademark search tools and obtain legal opinion where necessary
controls.reason: Legal & Compliance Department responsible for trademark search; Legal Advisory leads. Compliance and Branding contribute. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Application for registration
controls.control: Legal/Compliance Department
controls.additionalControl: Medium
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: At the point of filing and upon receipt of Registrar’s response
controls.reason: Primary responsibility text is 'High', which is nonsense. Best inference is Legal/Compliance Department for application filing. Low confidence due to ambiguous text.

controls.title: Opposition to registration.
controls.control: Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team
controls.additionalControl: Medium
controls.reason: Primary responsibility text is 'High', which is nonsense. Best inference is Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team for opposition. Low confidence due to ambiguous text.

controls.title: Registration
controls.control: Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team
controls.additionalControl: Medium
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Before expiry of current registration period
controls.reason: Primary responsibility text is 'High', which is nonsense. Best inference is Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team for registration. Low confidence due to ambiguous text.

controls.title: Duration and renewal of registration
controls.control: Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team
controls.additionalControl: Medium
controls.reason: Primary responsibility text is 'Medium', which is nonsense. Best inference is Legal/Compliance / Brand Protection Team for renewal. Low confidence due to ambiguous text.

controls.title: Assignability of trade marks
controls.control: Ensure assignment registration within 6 months; advertise per Registrar's direction.
controls.additionalControl: Legal review of IP clauses in M&A or JV transactions
controls.reason: Legal/IP Team maps to Legal Advisory; assignment registration and IP clause review are legal advisory functions.

controls.title: Registration to be prima facie evidence of validity
controls.control: Keep register updated; retain all registration certificates.
controls.additionalControl: Maintain IP portfolio log
controls.reason: Maintaining IP portfolio log and registration certificates is a legal advisory responsibility.

controls.act: Evidence Act, 2011
controls.title: Admissibility of Statements in Documents Produced by Computers
controls.control: Evidence certification policy; record audit trail; designate certifying officer
controls.additionalControl: System audit of records used in litigation
controls.reason: Multiple parties (Legal, IT, Compliance) share responsibility; Legal is most accountable for evidence certification policy, but ambiguity lowers confidence.

controls.title: Protects bank staff from improper compulsion
controls.control: Legal policy on external subpoenas and testimony
controls.additionalControl: Staff training on S.177 protections
controls.reason: Legal policy on subpoenas and staff training on legal protections is a legal advisory function.

controls.act: Guidelines on the Establishment and Rationalization of Branches and Other Outlets for Banks in Nigeria
controls.title: General Criteria for Establishing Banking Outlets
controls.control: Pre-submission checklist and internal review process
controls.additionalControl: Periodic compliance audits on submitted documentation
controls.reason: Regulatory Affairs/Branch Expansion maps to Regulatory Compliance; pre-submission checklist and internal review are compliance functions.

controls.title: Approval
controls.control: Track expiry dates using approval calendar
controls.additionalControl: Weekly report to Compliance on pending expirations
controls.reason: Tracking approval expiry dates and reporting to Compliance is a regulatory compliance responsibility.

controls.title: Revalidation of Approval to Open Branches and Other Banking Outlets
controls.control: System reminder 4 months before expiry
controls.additionalControl: Internal escalation workflow if not initiated
controls.reason: System reminders and escalation for branch approval revalidation is a regulatory compliance function.

controls.title:
Documentation Requirements for Closure of a Branch and Other Banking 
Outlets
controls.control: Internal policy and checklist for outlet changes; regulatory tracking
controls.additionalControl: Customer notification and internal governance review
controls.reason: Multiple parties (Compliance, Strategy, Branch Ops) share responsibility; Compliance is most accountable for regulatory tracking, but ambiguity lowers confidence.

controls.title: Other Requirements
controls.control: Checklist for each outlet action; dual review process
controls.additionalControl: Internal audit sampling of closed outlets
controls.reason: Multiple parties (Regulatory Reporting, Branch Management, Operations) compete for accountability; Compliance is inferred as most accountable for regulatory checklist, but low confidence.

controls.act: Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2007
controls.title: Lending by Financial Institutions
controls.control: Include fiscal responsibility checks in public sector credit appraisal.
controls.additionalControl: Obtain confirmation from DMO or relevant authority before disbursing loans to public entities.
controls.reason: Credit Risk is most accountable for public sector credit appraisal; Legal & Compliance contributes fiscal responsibility checks.

controls.act: Reporting Unethical Conduct/Whistle Blowing
controls.title: CBN Circular (April 2, 2015)
controls.control: Ethics training and reporting protocols; whistleblowing policy and escalation framework
controls.additionalControl: Establish internal whistleblowing desk with clear escalation.
controls.reason: CCO and Internal Audit share responsibility; Conduct & Ethics unit is most accountable for whistleblowing policy, but ambiguity lowers confidence.

controls.act: Guidelines for whistle-blowing for banks and other financial institutions in Nigeria
controls.title: Compliance
controls.control: Whistle-blowing policy; secure channels for anonymous and confidential reporting (email, hotline, web form).
controls.additionalControl: Staff onboarding training and periodic awareness campaigns
controls.reason: Whistleblowing policy and secure reporting channels are compliance conduct and ethics responsibilities.

controls.title: Whistle-blowing Procedures
controls.control: Documented procedure in internal policies and employee handbook. Ensure visibility of reporting options.
controls.additionalControl: Periodic policy review and updates
controls.reason: Whistle-blowing procedures fall under Compliance, specifically Conduct & Ethics. The Compliance Officer is the accountable role.

controls.title: Protection of the Whistle blower
controls.control: Include in employee code of conduct and disciplinary policy. Monitor HR actions relating to whistleblower reports.
controls.additionalControl: Independent reporting channel for retaliation cases
controls.reason: Protection of whistleblower involves HR, Legal, and Compliance. HR is most accountable for employee code of conduct and monitoring HR actions. Head of HR is the accountable role.

controls.act: Revised Assessment Criteria for Approved Persons' Regime for Financial Institutions
controls.title: CRITERIA FOR ASSESSING FITNESS (COMPETENCE AND CAPABILITY)
controls.control: Fitness assessments, training plans, performance reviews
controls.additionalControl: HR alert system, board oversight
controls.reason: Fitness assessments and training plans are HR responsibilities. Governance Committee is not a department in the org structure, so HR is accountable. Head of HR is the role.

controls.title: GENERAL GUIDELINES FOR ALL FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS
controls.control: Checklist of vetting documents, pre-appointment review
controls.additionalControl: Board dashboard for tracking status
controls.reason: Vetting documents and pre-appointment review are primarily HR functions, with Compliance and Legal as contributors. Head of HR is accountable.

controls.title:
FITNESS REQUIREMENTS FOR BANKS, DISCOUNT HOUSES AND 
DEVELOPMENT FINANCE INSTITUTIONS
controls.control: Role-specific fit and proper checklist, board/CBN vetting
controls.additionalControl: Pre-clearance by external governance consultant
controls.reason: Role-specific fit and proper checklist is HR responsibility. Nomination Committee is not in org structure. Head of HR is accountable.

controls.title: SIGNIFICANT SHAREHOLDERS FOR ALL FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS
controls.control: Shareholder due diligence, CBN clearance tracking
controls.additionalControl: Legal register and approval control system
controls.reason: Shareholder due diligence and CBN clearance tracking are primarily Company Secretariat functions, with Compliance as contributor. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.act: Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA) 2020
controls.title: Power to close Register
controls.control: SOP for closure including legal review and template for public notice.
controls.additionalControl: Legal sign-off before publication; tracking total closure days in a calendar.
controls.reason: Power to close register is a Company Secretariat responsibility. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.title: Power of Court to rectify register.
controls.control: Routine reconciliation of register with shareholder actions and filings.
controls.additionalControl: Legal review and dual verification of register updates; audit trail maintained.
controls.reason: Reconciliation of register is Company Secretariat responsibility, with Legal as contributor. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.title: Businesses transacted at annual general meeting.
controls.control: Board agenda vetting and legal review
controls.additionalControl: AGM scripts and training
controls.reason: Business transacted at AGM is Company Secretariat responsibility. Board Governance Committee is not in org structure. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.title: Extraordinary general meeting.
controls.control: Governance policy enabling shareholder-initiated EGMs
controls.additionalControl: Shareholder relations process
controls.reason: Extraordinary general meeting governance is Company Secretariat responsibility, with Legal/Compliance as contributor. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.title: Place of meeting.
controls.control: Venue policy and virtual meeting SOP
controls.additionalControl: Legal review of articles
controls.reason: Place of meeting policy is Company Secretariat responsibility. Company Secretary is accountable.

controls.title: Powers and duties of the chairman of the general meeting.
controls.control: Board charter and code of conduct
controls.additionalControl: Board training on CAMA duties
controls.reason: Powers and duties of chairman are governed by board charter, but Company Secretary typically supports. Board Chairman is not a role title in the list. Company Secretary is best fit.

controls.title: Minutes of proceedings and effect.
controls.control: Use of minute book, audio recording, legal review
controls.additionalControl: Audit of minutes by governance team
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for minute book and recording; Board Audit Committee contributes via audit of minutes; Internal Audit verifies governance processes.

controls.title: Number of directors.
controls.control: Director tracking system and board calendar
controls.additionalControl: Director appointment escalation process
controls.reason: Company Secretary maintains director tracking and board calendar; Nomination Committee contributes to appointment escalation; Internal Audit verifies board composition controls.

controls.title: Subsequent appointments of directors.
controls.control: Board succession plan and AGM protocols
controls.additionalControl: Director appointment matrix and legal backup
controls.reason: Company Secretary owns board succession and AGM protocols; Nomination and Governance Committee contributes to appointment matrix; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Casual vacancy.
controls.control: Pre-approved board size cap and AGM ratification process
controls.additionalControl: Real-time vacancy monitoring
controls.reason: Company Secretary is accountable for vacancy process; Board Chair and Board Governance Committee contribute; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Independent directors in public companies.
controls.control: Due diligence on all board appointments and independence checks
controls.additionalControl: Annual board evaluation and disclosure in financials
controls.reason: Company Secretary accountable for due diligence and independence checks; Nomination Committee and Board Nomination and Governance Committee contribute; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Disqualification for directorship.
controls.control: Pre-appointment due diligence; background checks.
controls.additionalControl: Annual board eligibility review.
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretary, HR, Board Nomination Committee
controls.reason: Company Secretary leads pre-appointment due diligence; HR and Board Nomination Committee contribute; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Vacation of office of director.
controls.control: Annual board fitness declarations; monitoring changes in directors' status.
controls.additionalControl: Maintain updated director profiles.
controls.reason: Company Secretary maintains director profiles and monitors status changes; Board contributes; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Duties of directors.
controls.control: Annual directors’ training; code of conduct; declaration of interest.
controls.additionalControl: Include in annual board evaluation.
controls.reason: Compliance (Conduct & Ethics) accountable for training, code of conduct, and declarations; Board, Risk, and Company Secretary contribute; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Conflicts of duties and interests.
controls.control: Conflict of interest policy; disclosure registers; whistleblowing.
controls.additionalControl: Board review of related-party transactions.
controls.reason: Compliance Officer accountable for conflict of interest policy and registers; Directors and Board Audit Committee contribute; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Secretaries
controls.control: Appointment policy; qualification check.
controls.additionalControl: Board monitoring via governance review.
controls.reason: Company Secretary accountable for appointment policy and qualification check; Board of Directors contributes; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Avoidance of acts done by a person as director and secretary.
controls.control: Role segregation; internal procedures.
controls.additionalControl: Oversight by Corporate Governance Committee.
controls.reason: Company Secretary accountable for role segregation and internal procedures; Board contributes; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Qualification of a Secretary.
controls.control: Verify professional credentials.
controls.additionalControl: Annual review of secretary qualifications.
controls.reason: Company Secretary accountable for verifying professional credentials; Board Nomination Committee contributes; Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Appointment and removal of a secretary.
controls.control: Documented removal procedure; legal vetting.
controls.additionalControl: Maintain records of all removal processes.
controls.reason: The Board of Directors is the primary responsible party for appointment and removal of a secretary, but the Company Secretariat maintains records and supports the process. The Company Secretary role is the most accountable operational role within the Company Secretariat unit.

controls.title: Fiduciary interests of a secretary.
controls.control: Confidentiality agreement; ethics training.
controls.additionalControl: Whistleblower channels.
controls.reason: The Company Secretary is directly responsible for fiduciary interests, confidentiality agreements, ethics training, and whistleblower channels. The Company Secretariat unit is the appropriate owner.

controls.title: Duties of a secretary.
controls.control: Compliance calendar; filing tracker.
controls.additionalControl: Automation of statutory tasks.
controls.reason: The Company Secretary is responsible for duties such as compliance calendar and filing tracker. The Company Secretariat unit is the correct owner.

controls.title: Provisions applicable to investigation.
controls.control: Internal legal review, training on rights and duties during investigation.
controls.additionalControl: Legal counsel oversight during inquiries.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Legal, Company Secretary'. Legal Advisory is the most accountable unit for legal review and training on rights during investigations. The Company Secretary is a contributor.

controls.title: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares, etc.
controls.control: Maintain up-to-date shareholder records; train staff on response protocol.
controls.additionalControl: Legal review of all disclosures.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Company Secretary / Legal'. The Company Secretary is accountable for maintaining shareholder records and response protocol, with Legal as a contributor for legal review.

controls.title: Power to impose restrictions on shares, etc.
controls.control: Compliance team liaises with SEC; Board oversight.
controls.additionalControl: Internal audit on share disclosures.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Legal / Company Secretary'. The Company Secretary is accountable for share restrictions and SEC liaison, with Legal and Compliance as contributors. Internal Audit verifies share disclosures.

controls.title: Savings for legal practitioners and bankers.
controls.control: Data protection policy; legal clearance process.
controls.additionalControl: External legal advice when needed.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Legal / Compliance'. Legal Advisory is accountable for legal clearance and data protection policy, with Compliance as a contributor. External legal advice is a contributor.

controls.title: Place, duration and form of records.
controls.control: Data retention policy; approved storage locations; audit trail of access; secure IT infrastructure.
controls.additionalControl: IT audits; back-up and recovery protocols; encryption and antivirus monitoring.
controls.responsibilityText: CFO, Head of IT, Records Management, Company Secretary
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists multiple parties: CFO, Head of IT, Records Management, Company Secretary. The CFO is the most accountable for records retention policy and storage, with IT, Records Management, and Company Secretary as contributors. Internal Audit verifies IT controls.

controls.title: Directors’ duty to prepare annual accounts.
controls.control: Annual financial reporting cycle; internal audit review.
controls.additionalControl: Board-level financial oversight.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Board, CFO, Company Secretary'. The CFO is accountable for the annual financial reporting cycle, with the Board and Company Secretary as contributors. Internal Audit reviews the process.

controls.title: Form and content of individual financial statements.
controls.control: Accounting policy manual; external audit.
controls.additionalControl: Review with external auditors.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'CFO, Internal Audit'. The CFO is accountable for the form and content of financial statements, with Internal Audit as a contributor for review. External audit is a contributor.

controls.title: Additional disclosure required in notes to financial statements.
controls.control: Disclosure checklist; audit review.
controls.additionalControl: Annual board remuneration disclosure review.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'CFO, Internal Audit'. The CFO is accountable for additional disclosures in notes, with Internal Audit as a contributor for review.

controls.title: Qualification of auditors.
controls.control: Auditor verification; appointment by AGM.
controls.additionalControl: Periodic rotation policy.
controls.reason: The primary responsibility text lists 'Audit Committee, CFO'. The CFO is accountable for auditor qualification verification and rotation policy, with the Audit Committee as a contributor. Internal Audit verifies the process.

controls.title: Auditors’ report and audit committee.
controls.control: Meeting schedule; filing calendar.
controls.additionalControl: External audit engagement letter.
controls.reason: CFO is accountable for financial reporting and audit committee coordination; Audit Committee is a contributor. Internal Audit verifies.

controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Head, Credit Risk Management; Head, Compliance
controls.reason: Credit Risk Management is most accountable for exposure tracking, limit alerts, concentration policy, and regulatory reporting; Compliance and Treasury contribute. Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Credit Concentration Policy
controls.control: Documented Credit Concentration Policy; Quarterly stress testing; Board-reviewed Credit Portfolio Plan
controls.additionalControl: Automated credit risk dashboards; Periodic internal reviews; SIC-based exposure tracking
controls.responsibilityText: Chief Risk Officer / Credit Risk Department
controls.reason: Chief Risk Officer / Credit Risk Department is explicitly responsible for Credit Concentration Policy, stress testing, and Credit Portfolio Plan; Internal Audit and Compliance contribute. Internal Audit verifies.

controls.title: Exposures to Directors and their related interests
controls.control: Board-approved credit policy covering insider lending; Disclosure in financial reports and regulatory returns; Related party lending limits tracked and monitored
controls.additionalControl: Related party credit register; Quarterly audit review; Automated exposure monitoring linked to core banking system
controls.responsibilityText: Chief Risk Officer / Head of Credit / Compliance
controls.reason: CRO is named first and is accountable for board-approved credit policy and related party lending limits; Head of Credit and Compliance contribute. Internal Audit performs quarterly audit review.

controls.title: Disclosure of Insider-related credits in financial statements:
controls.control: Proper classification of insider credits; Structured note disclosures; Internal reporting systems; Auditor/Audit Committee review
controls.additionalControl: Pre-year-end review of related-party positions; Auditor checklist for insider exposure compliance
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Finance Dept / Internal Audit / External Auditors
controls.reason: CFO/Head of Finance own financial statement disclosure and classification; Compliance contributes. Internal Audit and External Auditors review.

controls.title: Basic Information on Borrowers and Minimum Contents of Credit files
controls.control: Mandatory credit documentation checklist, credit bureau and CRMS search before disbursement, internal audit review, use of approved LAF, and standardized credit file requirements
controls.additionalControl: Automation of credit onboarding and documentation workflow; regular training for credit officers; quarterly credit file quality reviews
controls.reason: Credit Risk Management is solely responsible for credit documentation and onboarding controls; internal audit review is mentioned as a control.

controls.title: Minimum information on credit print-outs
controls.control: Standardized credit print-out template in core banking system; system validation rules; periodic compliance checks
controls.additionalControl: Quarterly audit of credit system outputs and credit file completeness review
controls.reason: Credit Risk owns the credit print-out template and validation rules; IT provides system support. Quarterly audit of outputs is the verification.

controls.title: Margin Lending
controls.control: Staff training, internal investment policy aligned with margin lending rules, compliance checks
controls.additionalControl: Periodic review of margin lending transactions for regulatory alignment
controls.reason: Treasury is listed first for margin lending controls; Investment and Credit Risk contribute. Compliance Unit performs periodic review, making accountability somewhat shared.

controls.title: Revaluation of fixed assets:
controls.control: Internal policy on asset revaluation, review of revaluation reports by management before CBN submission
controls.additionalControl: Annual internal audit review of asset valuations and compliance with CBN requirements
controls.reason: Finance/Financial Control owns asset revaluation policy and CBN submission; CFO is accountable. Annual internal audit review verifies.

controls.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
controls.control: Daily NOP monitoring reports, system limits aligned with CBN guidelines, independent compliance checks
controls.additionalControl: Regular training on FX limits; automated alerts for limit breaches
controls.reason: Market Risk Management owns daily NOP monitoring and FX limits; Treasury contributes. Independent compliance checks verify.

controls.title: Statutory reserve
controls.control: Reserve policy in accounting manual; annual reserve transfer review by internal audit and external auditors
controls.additionalControl: Periodic CBN compliance checks and Board oversight of profit appropriation
controls.reason: Finance/Financial Reporting owns statutory reserve policy and transfers; CFO/Head of Finance accountable. Internal audit and external auditors review.

controls.title: Dividend Pay-Out
controls.control: Board-approved dividend policy aligned with CBN guidance; finance and risk oversight on capital levels
controls.additionalControl: CBN circulars to be reviewed annually for updates; Board approval of any pay-out decision
controls.reason: Finance/Financial Reporting owns dividend pay-out policy and capital oversight; CFO accountable. Company Secretary contributes on Board approval. CBN compliance checks verify.

controls.title: Capital adequacy ratio (CAR)
controls.control: Ongoing capital monitoring; ICAAP process; regulatory returns; Board capital strategy
controls.additionalControl: Periodic stress testing; Early warning indicators; Compliance with Supervisory Intervention Framework
controls.reason: Finance/Regulatory Reporting owns CAR monitoring and ICAAP; CFO accountable, CRO and CEO contribute. Compliance with Supervisory Intervention Framework verifies.

controls.title: Credit rating of counter party/obligor and sector
controls.control: Internal credit risk model; quarterly obligor reviews; credit policy and sectoral risk guidelines
controls.additionalControl: External validation of models; alignment with IFRS 9 and Basel standards; periodic policy updates
controls.reason: Credit Risk/Risk Management owns internal credit risk models and obligor reviews; CRO/Head of Risk accountable. External validation and internal audit verify.

controls.title: Credit rating of Banks
controls.control: Annual engagement with reputable credit rating agency; rating report tracking and CBN submission calendar; rating disclosure procedures.
controls.additionalControl: Periodic internal audit checks on rating updates and disclosures.
controls.reason: Risk Management/Finance jointly responsible for bank credit rating engagement; Risk Management leads. Internal audit checks rating updates and disclosures.

controls.title: Reconciliation of inter-branch accounts and treatment of suspense account entries
controls.control: Daily reconciliation procedures; escalation matrix for unresolved entries; automation of reconciliation tracking.
controls.additionalControl: Monthly review by Internal Audit; system alerts for aged items.
controls.reason: Primary responsibility for reconciliation and suspense accounts lies with Finance/Internal Control, mapped to Financial Control under Finance & Treasury. Internal Audit performs monthly review as independent verification.

controls.title: Foreign currency loans
controls.control: Internal lending policy aligned with CBN directives; pre-lending FX income verification; approval limits
controls.additionalControl: Periodic review of borrower FX earnings profile; regulatory updates monitoring
controls.reason: Foreign currency lending is primarily a credit risk matter; Credit Risk unit is most accountable. Treasury and Compliance are contributors. Compliance verifies regulatory alignment.

controls.title: Policies and procedures for write-off of fully provided credit facilities
controls.control: Loan write-off policy, board resolution record, related party review, external audit checks
controls.additionalControl: Quarterly compliance audit of write-offs; escalation of non-compliance to Board Audit Committee
controls.responsibilityText: Credit Risk / Finance / Internal Audit / Compliance
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Credit Risk / Finance / Internal Audit / Compliance
controls.reason: Write-off policy for credit facilities is owned by Credit Risk. Finance, Internal Audit, and Compliance contribute. Internal Audit provides independent verification via quarterly compliance audit.

controls.title: Misreporting
controls.control: Independent external audit, internal financial controls, reporting policy, whistleblower channels
controls.additionalControl: Random forensic review of financial statements; CBN returns validation
controls.reason: Misreporting prevention is primarily a financial control responsibility. Compliance and Internal Audit contribute. Internal Audit verifies through forensic reviews and CBN returns validation.

controls.title: Lending to Customers
controls.control: Automated TIN and BVN validation before loan approval; system restrictions on disallowed customer types
controls.additionalControl: Periodic audit of customer loan database for eligibility compliance
controls.reason: Lending to customers is a credit risk function. Compliance and Legal contribute. Compliance verifies eligibility compliance through periodic audits.

controls.title: Tenured Positions
controls.control: Maintain tenure tracking systems; periodic board tenure reviews; enforce retirement schedules
controls.additionalControl: Annual corporate governance audit; regulatory compliance checklist
controls.responsibilityText: Company Secretary / HR / Internal Audit / Board Affairs
controls.additionalResponsibilityText: Company Secretary / HR / Internal Audit / Board Affairs
controls.reason: Tenured positions and board tenure tracking are managed by Company Secretariat. HR and Internal Audit contribute. Internal Audit verifies via annual corporate governance audit.

controls.title: Cooling Off Period
controls.control: Maintain exit records and reappointment trackers; embed cooling-off clauses in appointment letters
controls.additionalControl: Board and HR due diligence before director appointments; periodic CBN compliance review
controls.reason: Cooling-off period compliance for directors is a Company Secretariat responsibility. HR contributes. Compliance verifies through periodic CBN compliance review.

controls.title: Know your customer
controls.control: Customer onboarding procedures, periodic KYC reviews, staff training, CBN KYC policy integration
controls.additionalControl: Use of automated KYC systems; real-time alerts for anomalies; periodic audit reviews
controls.reason: KYC is a core compliance function, specifically AML/CFT. Operations contributes to onboarding. Internal Audit verifies through periodic audit reviews.

controls.title: Anti-money laundering measures
controls.control: AML/CFT policy, risk-based customer due diligence (CDD), suspicious transaction monitoring and reporting
controls.additionalControl: AML software for automated detection; staff certification; independent AML audit reviews
controls.reason: AML measures are directly owned by the AML/CFT unit under Compliance. Independent AML audit reviews provide verification.

controls.title: Record retention
controls.control: Document retention policy; secure storage (physical/electronic); record audit trails
controls.additionalControl: Regular record management audits; legal hold for litigation-related records
controls.reason: Record retention is a compliance responsibility, mapped to Data Protection for records management. Operations contributes. Internal Audit verifies through record management audits.

controls.title: Correspondent Banking
controls.control: Correspondent due diligence checklist; risk-based assessment; onboarding approvals
controls.additionalControl: Periodic re-evaluation of correspondent relationships; adverse media screening
controls.reason: Correspondent banking due diligence is an AML/CFT compliance function. Treasury contributes. Internal Audit verifies through periodic re-evaluation and screening reviews.

controls.title: Suspious Transactions
controls.control: Transaction monitoring systems; red flag indicators; staff training; internal escalation protocols
controls.additionalControl: Use of AI tools for behavioral transaction monitoring; regular internal audits
controls.reason: Suspicious transaction monitoring and reporting is a core AML/CFT responsibility. Internal Audit provides independent verification through regular audits.

controls.title:
Credit portfolio classification system for facilities other than 
“Specialized loans”
controls.control: Quarterly portfolio review, classification matrix, provisioning policy, audit trail, management oversight.
controls.additionalControl: Real-time credit monitoring tools; independent credit risk review committee.
controls.reason: Credit portfolio classification and provisioning policy is a credit risk management responsibility; 'Risk & Credit Units' maps to Credit Risk under Risk Management, with Head of Risk accountable.

controls.title: Provision for facilities other than “Specialized loans”
controls.control: Provisioning matrix linked to classification system, automated provisioning tools, IFRS 9 compliance, regulatory updates.
controls.additionalControl: Internal audit of provisioning accuracy, system validations, compliance assurance reviews.
controls.reason: Provisioning matrix and IFRS 9 compliance are primarily credit risk owned, with Finance as contributor; internal audit verifies provisioning accuracy.

controls.title: Credit portfolio classification system for “Specialized loans”
controls.control: Standardized classification templates, portfolio review calendar, automated loan tracking system, staff training, regulatory updates integration.
controls.additionalControl: Internal audits, system validation of overdue thresholds, compliance spot-checks, CBN feedback review loop.
controls.reason: Specialized loan classification is credit risk owned; Compliance contributes on regulatory updates and spot-checks, and is the independent verifier.

controls.title: Provisioning for “Specialized loans”
controls.control: Internal classification system, provisioning engine, periodic credit reviews, Board-approved policies
controls.additionalControl: Automation of classification and provisioning rules; regular audits and CBN compliance reviews
controls.reason: Provisioning for specialized loans is a credit risk function with Finance contributing; audits and CBN compliance reviews provide verification.

controls.title: Collateral Adjustment for Lost Facilities
controls.control: Collateral eligibility and enforceability reviews, independent valuation, legal due diligence
controls.additionalControl: Periodic training on haircut adjustment application; automation of provision calculations with validation checks
controls.reason: Collateral adjustment is primarily credit risk owned, with Finance and Legal as contributors; multiple parties compete for accountability, lowering confidence.

controls.title: Treatment of IFRS Impairment Charge for Prudential Purposes
controls.control: Monthly reconciliation of IFRS and prudential provisions; automated reserve adjustment entries; internal audit oversight
controls.additionalControl: External audit validation of reserve adjustments; board audit committee review
controls.reason: IFRS/prudential reconciliation and reserve adjustments are financial control responsibilities; internal audit provides oversight.

controls.title: Credit Portfolio Disclosure Requirement
controls.control: Credit MIS and reporting tools, internal audit verification, compliance checklist for financial disclosures
controls.additionalControl: External auditor verification; regulatory reviews (CBN, NDIC); board review of disclosures before publication
controls.reason: Credit portfolio disclosure is a regulatory reporting responsibility within Finance, with Risk Management contributing; internal audit verifies.

controls.title: Disclosure Requirement for “Specialized loans”
controls.control: Disclosure checklists, automated reporting systems, cross-validation with credit risk classification data, external auditor review.
controls.additionalControl: Internal disclosure audits, regulatory disclosure mapping, training for Finance team on loan classifications.
controls.reason: Specialized loan disclosure is owned by Finance & Regulatory Reporting; internal disclosure audits verify.

controls.title: Interest Accrual
controls.control: Revenue recognition policy, NPL tracking, loan aging analysis, interest suspension after 90 days overdue, IFRS-compliant provisioning framework.
controls.additionalControl: Internal audit review of accrued interest and loss provisioning on NPLs.
controls.reason: Interest accrual and NPL tracking are credit risk owned with Finance contributing; internal audit reviews accruals and provisioning.

controls.title: Revolving and Overdraft Facilities
controls.control: Facility structuring SOPs, clean-up cycle monitoring, turnover validation, account behavior tracking, classification framework, credit system alerts, provisioning policy, rescheduling assessment.
controls.additionalControl: Quarterly independent credit file reviews and system-based alerts for limit/turnover violations.
controls.reason: Revolving/overdraft facility controls are credit risk owned; 'Internal Control Units' is ambiguous and mapped to Compliance/Monitoring & Testing as contributors.

controls.title: Facilities without Approval
controls.control: System controls to prevent unauthorized overdrafts, daily exception monitoring, and escalation procedures.
controls.additionalControl: Automated alerts for overdrawn accounts and compliance review of exception cases.
controls.reason: Unauthorized overdraft prevention is branch operations owned with Branch Manager accountable; credit operations is not a listed unit, and compliance reviews exceptions.

controls.title: NPL Limit
controls.control: Strict credit appraisal and approval process, portfolio monitoring, early warning signals, recovery efforts, and regular NPL reporting to management and regulators.
controls.additionalControl: Automated NPL ratio tracking, portfolio stress testing, and credit portfolio audits.
controls.reason: NPL limit monitoring and reporting are credit risk management responsibilities; internal audit verifies through portfolio audits.

controls.title: Financial soundness indicators and financial ratios
controls.control: Quarterly computation of ratios, benchmarking, and board reporting; internal policy on financial soundness monitoring.
controls.additionalControl: Independent validation by internal audit and CBN review of financial health reports.
controls.reason: Primary responsibility lists Risk Management first; financial soundness monitoring and board reporting is an enterprise risk function, with Finance contributing data and Internal Audit independently validating.

controls.reason: Dispute resolution protocol and PenCom escalation liaison is a regulatory compliance function.

controls.title: Employer Deduction and Remittance
controls.control: Automated payroll deduction and payment calendar

controls.control: NSITF registration and monthly contribution

controls.reason: HR and HSE share responsibility for safety briefings and reporting; HSE Officer supports. Compliance verifies.

controls.reason: HR and HSE lead incident reports and eligibility checks; Legal provides vetting. Compliance verifies.

controls.reason: HR and Line Managers share responsibility for fair work allocation and grievance mechanisms. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Compensation for Injuries Outside the Normal Workplace

controls.reason: HR and Department Heads share responsibility for written task assignments. Compliance verifies.

controls.reason: Legal and HR share responsibility for handbook and onboarding awareness; Legal Officer supports. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Contribution by Employees Prohibited
controls.control: Payroll checklist, review by compliance

controls.reason: Payroll (under Finance) and Compliance lead payroll checklist; Payroll Manager supports. Internal Audit verifies.

controls.control: Employee next-of-kin records; HR/legal coordination
controls.additionalControl: Bereavement SOP
controls.reason: HR and Legal coordinate next-of-kin records and bereavement SOP; HR Officer supports. Compliance verifies.

controls.title: Permanent Total Disability

controls.title: Permanent Partial Disability or Disfigurement

controls.reason: HR and HSE coordinate medical records and disability tracker; HR Admin supports. Compliance verifies.

controls.act: Trade Union (Amendment) Act, 2005

controls.title: Deduction and Remittance of Union Dues

controls.reason: Primary responsibility 'Payroll/Finance' maps to Financial Control under Finance & Treasury; Financial Controller is accountable. Internal Audit verifies deduction and remittance checks.

controls.title: Collective Bargaining via Electoral College
controls.control: Recognition policy for union reps; participation framework

controls.title: Termination of contracts by notice
